Today, we honor our veterans for their courage, sacrifice, and love of country.

America is forever indebted to you.

What you described on 60 Minutes is what the Dignity Act is all about.

A Republican-led immigration bill with BIPARTISAN support.

“Get the killers out.” You said it. ABSOLUTELY!

You said it: Keep “good people working in a landscaping company, or working in a hotel” who have been contributing to America for years.

You said it: Those who have been here for 10 or 15 years: “Work a deal for them.”

That’s the core of the Dignity legislation.

Immigration is not just border security. It’s about the ECONOMY and AFFORDABILITY: housing, groceries, healthcare, manufacturing. 

Mr. President, I have said it repeatedly. YOU can bring Republicans and Democrats together to finally fix our broken immigration system. 

A 40-year problem.

You can surpass Reagan’s legacy by delivering a historic immigration reform.

This is your moment.

Hoy, en las Naciones Unidas, vimos un espectáculo lamentable que retrata al régimen de cuerpo entero: gritos, interrupciones e intimidación cuando alguien se atreve a decirles la verdad en la cara.

Es la misma táctica que han usado durante décadas contra el pueblo cubano: cuando no pueden defender sus fracasos, intentan silenciar a quien los denuncia.

Sus días están contados.

I commend @michaelgwaltz for exposing the Cuban dictatorship’s corruption, abuses, and lies before the world.

Today at the United Nations, the regime put its tactics on full display: shouting down its critics, disrupting the proceedings, and attempting to intimidate those who dare to confront it with the truth.

It is the same playbook the dictatorship has used against the Cuban people for decades. When it cannot defend the indefensible, it resorts to intimidation and censorship.

They can shout all they want. Their days are numbered.

Mexico is breaking the rules and helping Havana profit from forced labor.

More than 3,000 Cuban doctors are working in Mexico under a program the U.S. State Department has classified as forced labor.

That’s why I sent a letter to U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer urging him to hold Mexico accountable under the USMCA and press for an end to this abusive practice.

The USMCA is not optional. Mexico cannot benefit from free trade with the United States while enabling the Cuban dictatorship to exploit its doctors.

Thirty years is a long time to wait for justice. It is not long enough to erase murder.

The families of the Brothers to the Rescue victims have carried this fight for three decades. Today, the law is still moving in their direction.

Raúl Castro should have to answer for what https://t.co/z8k1yKHudh

Happy 251st Birthday to the United States Navy! ⚓🇺🇸

For more than two and a half centuries, America’s sailors have answered the call to defend our nation, safeguard our seas, and protect freedom around the world.

Today, we salute every sailor, past and present, who has served our country with courage, honor, and sacrifice. Fair winds and following seas!

Choosing a life of service takes something special. 🇺🇸

Last night, students and families from across our community took an important step toward our nation’s U.S. Service Academies and learned more about the congressional nomination process through my office.

It is one of the great privileges of serving in Congress to help open that door for young people willing to lead, sacrifice, and serve our country.

Miami should be proud of them.

Thank you to American Legion Post 98 for hosting us and supporting the next generation of American leaders.

Three years ago today, the Jewish people suffered their deadliest day since the Holocaust.

We remember the innocent lives taken on October 7. We mourn with their families and honor the memory of every victim.

Three years later, we have not forgotten. We will not forget.

America stands with the Jewish people, with Israel, and against the evil of terrorism and antisemitism. 🇺🇸🇮🇱

posts.text:
¿Listo para servir a nuestro país? 🇺🇸

Mañana celebramos en Coral Gables nuestro Día de las Academias Militares.

Estudiantes y familias podrán conocer a representantes de las Academias, aprender sobre el proceso de admisión y cómo obtener una nominación congresional.

📅 Mañana, 7 de octubre
⏰ 5:30–7:30 PM
📍 American Legion Post 98 | Coral Gables

Tu camino hacia una Academia de Servicio puede comenzar aquí.

¡Regístrate hoy y asegura tu lugar! Escanea el código QR o visita el enlace.

Tomorrow, the path to service begins in Coral Gables. 🇺🇸

I’m inviting South Florida’s next generation of leaders to join us for Service Academy Day and explore what it takes to earn a place at one of our nation’s U.S. Service Academies.

Meet Academy representatives, learn about the admissions process, and understand how to earn a congressional nomination.

📅 Tomorrow, October 7
⏰ 5:30–7:30 PM
📍 American Legion Post 98 | Coral Gables

For those ready to lead, serve, and represent our country, this could be the first step toward an extraordinary future.

Scan the QR code or use the link below to register.

Miami está hecho de personas que convierten ideas en oportunidades.

Anoche acompañé a la Cámara de Comercio de Mujeres Hispanas de Estados Unidos para celebrar a emprendedoras que están creando negocios, generando empleos y fortaleciendo nuestra economía.

También tuve el orgullo de entregar a la Cámara un reconocimiento del Congreso por su trabajo en nuestra comunidad.

Eso es el Sueño Americano en acción: trabajar duro, construir algo propio y crear oportunidades para otros.

¡Felicidades a todas las mujeres que celebramos anoche! 🇺🇸

Miami is built by people who turn ideas into opportunity.

Last night, I joined the U.S. Hispanic Women’s Chamber of Commerce to celebrate entrepreneurs who are building businesses, creating jobs, and strengthening our economy.

I was also proud to present the Chamber with a Congressional recognition honoring its work in our community.

That is the American Dream in action: work hard, build something of your own, and create opportunities for others.

Congratulations to all the women we celebrated last night! 🇺🇸

Hoy, Anna Bensi, de apenas 21 años, y su madre, Caridad, enfrentan un juicio en La Habana, mientras la Seguridad del Estado vigila las casas de periodistas y activistas que intentan acompañarlas.

Mientras la dictadura cubana se derrumba bajo el peso de sus propios fracasos, la represión es lo único que le queda. Pero voces como la de Anna se hacen cada vez más fuertes.

Con apenas 21 años, Anna representa la valentía de tantos cubanos que se niegan a dejarse intimidar y guardar silencio.

Anna y Caridad, hoy estamos con ustedes.

Today, 21-year-old Anna Bensi and her mother, Caridad, are facing trial in Havana, while State Security surrounds the homes of journalists and activists trying to attend.

As the Cuban dictatorship collapses under the weight of its own failures, repression is all it has left. But voices like Anna’s are only getting stronger.

At just 21, she represents the courage of Cubans who refuse to be intimidated into silence.

Anna and Caridad, today we stand with you. 🇨🇺

For students called to serve 🇺🇸

On October 7, I’m hosting Service Academy Day in Coral Gables for students and families interested in pursuing an education at one of our nation’s U.S. Service Academies.

Come meet representatives, learn about the admissions process, and find out what it takes to earn a congressional nomination.

📅 October 7
⏰ 5:30–7:30 PM
📍 American Legion Post 98, Coral Gables

Your path to a Service Academy could start here. Scan the QR code or use the link below to register!

Cutler Bay sabe cómo celebrar a su gente. 

Me encantó compartir con tantas familias en Cutler Ridge Park durante la celebración del Mes de la Herencia Hispana,  música, comida, niños disfrutando y toda una comunidad reunida.

Y llegué con buenas noticias: $2 millones para Cutler Bay, $1 millón para Saga Bay y $1 millón para Lakes by the Bay para mejorar el drenaje, reducir las inundaciones y ayudar a proteger la bahía de Biscayne.

Celebrando nuestras raíces y, al mismo tiempo, cuidando la comunidad que llamamos hogar.

Cutler Bay knows how to celebrate its community. 

I loved spending time with families at Cutler Ridge Park for the Hispanic Heritage Celebration,  music, food, kids, and so many neighbors enjoying the evening together.

And I came with good news: $2 million for Cutler Bay, $1 million for Saga Bay and $1 million for Lakes by the Bay to improve drainage, reduce flooding, and help protect Biscayne Bay.

Celebrating our roots while taking care of the community we call home.

Muy orgullosa de acompañar a Mount Sinai en la apertura de su nuevo Centro de Emergencias en Westchester, aquí en el Distrito 27.

Nuestras familias merecen salud de calidad, asequible y cerca de casa.

En el Congreso, seguiré trabajando para bajar costos y fortalecer la atención médica en nuestra comunidad.

¡Felicidades a todo el equipo de Mount Sinai!

Proud to join the Mount Sinai family for the opening of its new medical Emergency Center in Westchester, right here in Florida’s 27th District.

Our families deserve quality, affordable healthcare close to home.

That’s what I’ll keep working for in Congress: lower costs, stronger healthcare, and more support for the doctors and nurses who take care of our community.

Congratulations to the entire Mount Sinai team on this important milestone.

Great visit with the Citi team in Miami today!

We talked about banking, AI, innovation, and how we keep our economy growing.

Miami is becoming one of America’s most important centers for finance and investment, while remaining our gateway to Latin America.

As a member of the House Financial Services Committee, I always value hearing directly from the people doing the work and investing in our community.

Thank you to Woodward Middleton and the entire Citi team for the warm welcome!

Ambassador @yechielleiter is a personal friend and an outstanding human being who has served Israel above and beyond the call of duty. 

The Lord of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob is upon him as his son Neria fights for his life after a horrific terrorist attack.

We know our God is Almighty. We hold on to faith and the power of prayer as HIS merciful hand makes a healing miracle.

🇺🇸 Could a U.S. Service Academy be in your future?

On October 7, I’m hosting Service Academy Day in Coral Gables for students and families interested in learning what it takes to attend one of our nation’s Service Academies.

Come hear more about the academies, the admissions process, and how to pursue a congressional nomination.

For young people ready to push themselves, serve our nation, and answer the call to leadership, this is a great place to start.

📅 October 7
⏰ 5:30–7:30 PM
📍 American Legion Post 98, Coral Gables

Scan the QR code or use the link below to register.

I hope to see you there! 🇺🇸

Siempre es un placer conversar con Marilys Llanos de Telemundo 51 y poner sobre la mesa los temas que hoy marcan la conversación en el Sur de la Florida.

No se pierdan la entrevista completa este domingo en Enfoque. https://t.co/EQ4eXKNwS8

On Yom Kippur, I join Jewish families in South Florida, across America, and around the world in this sacred time of prayer, reflection, and renewal.

May this Day of Atonement bring peace, strength, and hope for the year ahead.

G’mar Chatima Tova.

La detención de Javier Oropeza es un grave retroceso para la transición en Venezuela.

Que un opositor regrese al país después de más de dos años en el exilio y termine detenido apenas 48 horas después demuestra que el aparato de persecución sigue vivo.

No puede haber una transición real con las mismas estructuras que durante años persiguieron, encarcelaron y silenciaron a los venezolanos.

El SEBIN y todo el aparato represivo tienen que ser desmantelados. Venezuela necesita libertad, no miedo.

Susie Wiles has faced this journey with extraordinary courage and grace.

So happy to hear this wonderful news for Susie and her family, and grateful for her continued service and dedication to our country.

May God continue to bless her with good health and many wonderful years ahead.

A house of worship should be a place of peace, prayer, and community.

Yesterday, the Pray Safe Act moved forward in committee by voice vote. I’m proud to lead this bipartisan effort with Congresswoman Grace Meng to help faith communities better prepare for threats, know where to turn for help, and access the resources they need to protect their congregations.

This is about keeping people safe while protecting something fundamental: the freedom to worship.

Now, we take it to the House.

La resiliencia ambiental empieza antes de la próxima tormenta.

Ver un problema antes de que se convierta en una crisis significa actuar. Por eso llevé más de $2.4 millones a Key Biscayne.

$2 millones ayudarán a reducir las inundaciones alrededor de Key Biscayne K-8 y $412,500 apoyarán un estudio de la Universidad de Miami sobre cómo un arrecife mar adentro podría frenar la erosión y proteger nuestra costa.

Mi trabajo en el Congreso es traer al sur de la Florida los recursos que necesita y convertirlos en resultados aquí en casa. Y eso es exactamente lo que estoy haciendo.

Environmental resilience starts before the next storm.

Seeing a problem before it becomes a crisis means doing the work to solve it. That’s why I delivered more than $2.4 million for Key Biscayne.

$2 million will help address flooding around Key Biscayne K-8, and $412,500 will support a University of Miami study on how an offshore reef could help reduce beach erosion and protect our coastline.

My job in Congress is simple: fight for the resources South Florida needs and make sure they deliver results here at home. And that’s exactly what I’m doing.

Beijing is expanding its reach in our own backyard.

China is pouring hundreds of millions into Punta Huete, an airbase in Nicaragua capable of accommodating strategic bombers. A Chinese bomber operating from there could be in Washington, D.C in three hours.

So today, I asked the State Department directly: Are we concerned about this growing foothold in our hemisphere?

Because if we are, we have to stop it before it becomes permanent.
